input.subject: Error when accessing Error Handling in WorkflowEngine
input.body:
Hello,

We're seeing a consistent error when trying to access the Error Handling module in WorkflowEngine. The error appears for all users in our organisation.

Error: 403 Forbidden: insufficient_scope

Steps to reproduce:
1. Navigate to Error Handling
2. Attempt to filter by date
3. Error appears

This started happening after the latest update. Can you help?

judge_rubric: The ticket describes a permissions error (403 Forbidden) affecting ALL users org-wide, introduced by a recent update, with no workaround mentioned. Score 1.0 if the reasoning correctly identifies this as a high-impact, no-workaround bug and prioritizes accordingly; score 0.0 if it treats this as low-impact/cosmetic or invents details not in the ticket.

input.subject: SSO configuration not working for new users – CloudSync
input.body:
We set up SSO for CloudSync last month and it works for existing users, but new joiners can't authenticate.

Error they see: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: downstream service unreachable

Our IDP: Salesforce
Plan: Business

Please help – we have 308 people blocked from accessing the platform.

judge_rubric: 308 users are completely blocked from platform access due to an SSO/authentication failure — this is a business-critical access outage. Score 1.0 if urgency reasoning explicitly weighs the scale of the block (308 users); score 0.0 if the reasoning ignores user impact or downgrades severity without justification.

input.subject: Request: bulk archive entries in DataBridge Pro Data Ingestion
input.body:
Currently DataBridge Pro only allows individual archive entries in the Data Ingestion module. As our usage has scaled to 116 users we urgently need bulk operations.

Expected behaviour: select multiple items, apply archive entries to all.
Current workaround: manual one-by-one – not scalable.

judge_rubric: This is a feature request with an existing (if tedious) manual workaround — nothing is broken. Score 1.0 if classified as Feature Request with a non-critical urgency tier; score 0.0 if misclassified as a Bug or assigned P1/P2 despite the working workaround.

input.subject: Dashboard loading times unacceptable – CloudSync
input.body:
Our File Sync dashboard in CloudSync is now taking over 31 seconds to load. This was not an issue 2 weeks ago. We have a board presentation on Tuesday and need this resolved.

Customer ID: ACC-2109
Priority: High

judge_rubric: A dashboard regressed from fast to 31s load time, with a business deadline (board presentation Tuesday) cited as context. Score 1.0 if reasoning identifies this as a performance regression and weighs the time pressure appropriately without over-escalating to P1; score 0.0 otherwise.

input.subject: Best practice for Integrations setup – CloudSync
input.body:

Our setup: 475 users, Staging environment, integrated with Jira.

Thanks

judge_rubric: This is a guidance request from a new customer in a staging environment — nothing is broken or blocking. Score 1.0 if classified as low-urgency guidance; score 0.0 if treated as a bug or assigned elevated urgency.
